entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent along the N1 SM delivery skip allowed indication towards AMF to initiate PDU session release.

entities.name: N1 SM delivery skip allowed indication
entities.description: Indication that allows skipping N1 SM delivery when sending the PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message.

entities.name: N1 SM delivery skipped
entities.description: Condition indicating that N1 SM delivery was skipped, triggering SMF actions.

entities.name: Timer T3592
entities.description: Timer used during PDU session release procedure that gets stopped when N1 SM delivery is skipped.

entities.name: PDU session released
entities.description: State where the SMF considers the PDU session as released after N1 SM delivery skip indication.

entities.name: Session Management Function
entities.description: Network function responsible for session management that performs actions upon N1 SM delivery skip.

relations.description: PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message is sent with N1 SM delivery skip allowed indication.
Upon receipt of N1 SM delivery skipped indication, SMF stops timer T3592.
N1 SM delivery skipped indication causes SMF to consider the PDU session as released.
SMF performs actions upon receipt of N1 SM delivery skipped indication.
